questions.questionText: A business has assets of $1,020 and liabilities of $307. Calculate owner's capital.
questions.explanation: Capital = assets − liabilities = $713.

questions.questionText: Which statement is correct about double entry?

options.text: It follows an identifiable accounting rule or procedure
It applies only to cash sales
It eliminates the need for ledgers
It is unrelated to financial reporting

questions.explanation: The first statement correctly describes the accounting treatment or principle involved.

questions.questionText: An accounting amount of $5,075.00 is subject to a 15% adjustment. What is the adjustment?
Which option best represents the normal treatment of books of original entry?

options.text: Apply the relevant accounting principle consistently and document the transaction
Ignore the transaction until year end
Record only the cash effect
Post the same amount twice

questions.explanation: Accounting treatment should follow the applicable principle and maintain an auditable record.
